display_long_description:
Air Conditioner Maintenance is an immersive VR training application developed to simulate real-world AC servicing and maintenance procedures. Through interactive scenarios, learners gain practical experience in inspection, troubleshooting, cleaning, and system handling—helping build confidence and job-ready skills in a safe virtual setting.

This application is an integral component of the Immerse Learn Air Conditioner Maintenance micro-credential program. It is not a standalone product—only individuals officially enrolled in the program will have access. The VR experience is designed to complement structured learning, allowing users to apply theoretical knowledge through guided, hands-on practice.

Ideal for workforce training and skill development, this application helps bridge the gap between learning and real-world performance using advanced immersive technology.
